def can_partition(S, k):
    import itertools
    n = len(S)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        s1 = 0
        for j in range(n):
            if (i >> j) & 1:
                s1 += S[j]
        if s1 <= 1 and (k - s1) <= 6:
            return True
    return False
